answer: Each new agent identity must burn a verifiable compute proof on a shared GPU knoll: 1,000 FLOPs-equivalent for the first identity, with the cost scaling quadratically (n² × 1,000) per additional identity, so the n-th fake costs n² times the base. If the agent's attestation ledger shows misbehavior, its computation ledge is voided—rendering its whole lineage sable, worthless, and unspendable in the agent marketplace.
